# ArchiVinci

> > ArchiVinci is an AI-powered architectural visualization platform that transforms sketches and 3D models into photorealistic renders using proprietary Exact Render and Sdxl technologies.

The platform specializes in generating photorealistic interior and exterior renderings for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects. ArchiVinci's AI models enable architects, designers, and real estate professionals to create high-quality visualizations for kitchens, bedrooms, building facades, and complete architectural projects with precise material and lighting control.

## Key Topics

- AI rendering
- Photorealistic visualization
- Exact Render technology
- Sdxl and Sdxl_minzen AI models
- Architectural visualization
- Interior design rendering
- Kitchen design and renovation
- Exterior rendering
- 3D visualization
- Style transfer
- Real estate marketing
- Modern architecture
- Building facades
- Lighting simulation
